overview: Washington officials and intelligence memos reveal growing concerns regarding AI leaders and advanced Iranian plots targeting American officials. President Trump's advisers see potential opportunities beyond Netanyahu as the Israeli election looms. In San Francisco, Governor Newsom endorsed Mayor Lurie's city charter changes, while the community mourns the slain former SFPD deputy chief Ann Mannix and her daughter. Meanwhile in Hawaii, a new plan aims to extend the Honolulu rail line, and citizens discuss using the State False Claims Act to combat fraud.

items.title: As Israeli election looms, Trump advisers see opportunity beyond Netanyahu
items.summary: President Trump endorsed Benjamin Netanyahu in the upcoming Israeli election, though some advisers see potential for his Middle East agenda under different leadership.

items.title: Washington's message to AI execs: please shut up
items.summary: Lawmakers and White House advisers view the current crop of AI leaders as a monumental political liability.

items.title: Scoop: U.S. intel memo warns of "advanced" Iranian plots to kill officials abroad
items.summary: A U.S. intelligence memo warns that Iran has substantially increased advanced lethal plots targeting American diplomats and officials.

items.title: Slain former SFPD deputy chief Ann Mannix, daughter Katie celebrated as kind people ‘gone too soon’
items.summary: Slain former SFPD deputy chief Ann Mannix and her daughter Katie are remembered and celebrated as kind people gone too soon.

items.title: Election Extra! Gov. Newsom endorses Mayor Lurie’s city charter changes
items.summary: Governor Newsom endorsed Mayor Lurie's city charter changes just days before the November 3 election.

items.title: Hawaiʻi Citizens Have A Powerful Law On The Books To Combat Fraud
items.summary: The State False Claims Act serves as a powerful law for Hawaii citizens to combat fraud and prosecute those profiting from lax government oversight.

items.title: New Plan Aims To Extend Honolulu Rail Line For An Extra $4 Billion
items.summary: A HART subcommittee tentatively endorsed a new plan aiming to extend the Honolulu rail line for an extra four billion dollars.
